title: Genitive Case & Academic Prepositions
subtitle: Elevate your written and spoken German with 'wegen, trotz, während, aufgrund' and crisp Genitive noun endings.

cheatSheet.summary: The Genitive expresses possession ('of / 's') and powers formal, journalistic, and B2-level prepositions like wegen (because of), trotz (despite), während (during), and aufgrund (due to).
keyTakeaways: Articles: Masculine [M] & Neuter [N] → 'des / eines' AND the noun adds '-s' or '-es' (des Mannes, des Wetters).
Feminine [F] & Plural [PL] → 'der / einer / meiner' (NO '-s' on the noun: 'trotz der Kälte', 'wegen der Probleme').
Use '-es' on short one-syllable nouns or nouns ending in s/ß/x/z (des Hauses, des Platzes); use '-s' on multi-syllable nouns (des Bahnhofs, des Urlaubs).
Adjectives after ANY Genitive article ALWAYS end in '-en' ('trotz des starken Regens').

patterns.example: Wegen des Regens bleiben wir hier.
patterns.translation: Because of the rain we stay here.

patterns.example: Trotz der Kälte geht er joggen.
patterns.translation: Despite the cold he goes jogging.
During the conversation he stayed silent.

patterns.example: Aufgrund der Bauarbeiten gibt es Stau.
patterns.translation: Due to construction there is traffic.

cheatSheet.watchOut: Colloquial speech often replaces Genitive with Dative ('wegen dem Regen'), but B2 exams, news, and professional writing require true Genitive ('wegen des Regens')!

exercises.prompt: Wegen ___ starken Regens wurde das Spiel abgesagt.
exercises.english: Because of the heavy rain the match was canceled.
exercises.fullGerman: Wegen des starken Regens wurde das Spiel abgesagt.
exercises.rulePill: 'wegen' takes Genitive → Masculine [M] 'der Regen' transforms into 'des Regens' (article 'des' + noun '-s').

exercises.prompt: Trotz ___ großen Müdigkeit beendete sie den Bericht.
exercises.english: Despite the great fatigue she finished the report.
exercises.fullGerman: Trotz der großen Müdigkeit beendete sie den Bericht.

nouns.caseTrigger: '-keit' is Feminine [F] → Genitive takes 'der' (no '-s' on noun)

exercises.rulePill: 'trotz' takes Genitive → Feminine [F] 'die Müdigkeit' becomes 'der Müdigkeit' (no '-s' ending on feminine nouns).

exercises.prompt: Während ___ Urlaubs habe ich drei Romane gelesen.
exercises.english: During my vacation I read three novels.
exercises.fullGerman: Während meines Urlaubs habe ich drei Romane gelesen.

nouns.caseTrigger: Preposition 'während' triggers Genitive → Masculine takes '-es' on possessive + '-s' on noun

exercises.rulePill: 'während' triggers Genitive → Masculine [M] possessive 'mein' becomes 'meines Urlaubs'.

exercises.prompt: Das ist die Tasche ___ neuen Kollegen.
exercises.english: That is the bag of the new colleague.
exercises.fullGerman: Das ist die Tasche des neuen Kollegen.
exercises.rulePill: Possession uses Genitive ('des') and weak masculine N-declension nouns like 'der Kollege' take '-n' instead of '-s': 'des Kollegen'.

exercises.promptHint: Short Neuter nouns need a Genitive noun ending after 'des'!
exercises.english: The windows of the house are freshly cleaned.
exercises.fullGerman: Die Fenster des Hauses sind frisch geputzt.
exercises.rulePill: Masculine/Neuter nouns ending in s/ß/z/x (like 'das Haus') add '-es' in Genitive for pronunciation: 'des Hauses'.

exercises.prompt: Anstatt ___ Autos kauft er sich ein E-Bike.
exercises.english: Instead of a car he is buying himself an e-bike.
exercises.fullGerman: Anstatt eines Autos kauft er sich ein E-Bike.
exercises.rulePill: 'anstatt / statt' takes Genitive → Neuter [N] 'ein Auto' becomes 'eines Autos'.

exercises.prompt: Aufgrund ___ hohen Kosten wurde das Projekt verschoben.
exercises.english: Due to the high costs the project was postponed.
exercises.fullGerman: Aufgrund der hohen Kosten wurde das Projekt verschoben.
exercises.rulePill: In Genitive Plural [PL], 'die' becomes 'der' and the adjective takes '-en': 'aufgrund der hohen Kosten'.

exercises.instruction: Front the Genitive phrase in Position 1 and keep the finite verb in Position 2.
exercises.english: Despite the bad weather we went on a hike.
exercises.fullGerman: Trotz des schlechten Wetters machten wir eine Wanderung.
exercises.rulePill: The entire Genitive phrase fills Position 1, so the finite verb 'machten' immediately holds Position 2.

exercises.promptHint: Check the adjective ending after a Genitive article!
exercises.english: Within a short period of time he learned fluent German.
exercises.fullGerman: Innerhalb eines kurzen Zeitraums lernte er fließend Deutsch.
exercises.rulePill: After ANY Genitive article ('des, der, eines, einer'), the adjective ALWAYS ends in '-en': 'eines kurzen Zeitraums'.
